overview.title: How contribution works here
overview.intro: Every contribution is scored across 22 dimensions. Work only counts when it produces a verified result — showing up, talking, or pausing never earns anything. Each score is adjusted by how well the work matched the intent, what it actually achieved, how strongly it was verified, and the DAO's latest tuning. Scores can't be transferred between people, and the overall score gates access and quorum but never makes votes heavier.
overview.antigaming: The system watches for its own failure modes: fake identities get no credit with Fool; attendance or talk without verified results earns nothing anywhere; staged disputes are rejected by Empress and Lovers; fake endings are rejected by Death; captured reviewers get swapped out by Moon; people who exploit system settings get exposed by Devil and audited by Justice; and work that is systematically missed triggers back-pay, retuning, or rule retirement.
overview.dependencies: Priestess's records support every dimension; Moon verifies pending claims for everyone; Magician's accepted work feeds Empress's nurturing, and Hierophant's proven skills feed it too; Hermit's and Hanged Man's findings reach Judgement at round end; Death's released resources feed Temperance's health measure; Star's orientation work feeds Fool's entry; Devil's distortion reports reach Justice and the final scoring; Justice's audits retune the weights for scoring; the round backbone — Wheel, Judgement, World — opens the final scoring; Emperor's adopted rules update the tuning; Sun's public recognition must tie to a proven record; Tower's crises must be verified by Moon.

diagrams.title: Master Contribution Lifecycle
diagrams.description: How any action becomes a contribution. The member records what happened, the system scores it across all 22 dimensions, reviewers check it, harm pulls the score down, and at the end of each round the 22 tallies combine into the overall score.
whoActs: Software spot-checks are audited at random
Two independent reviewers write their reasons for important work
A rotating panel handles appeals on a deadline

glossary.plain: Score the action across all 22 dimensions
glossary.technical: classify into sparse vector P(a) = [p_0 … p_21]
unverified — no delta; judgment stays pending and settles retroactively

glossary.plain: Check for harm and reduce the score
glossary.technical: verified harm reduces or voids the outcome

glossary.plain: Score each dimension and update 22 tallies
glossary.technical: delta C_i(a) = Match × Outcome × Verification × Calibration → 22 non-transferable balances
explanation record — action ID, dimensions, intensities, calibration version
cycle boundary: C_10 Wheel → C_20 Judgement → C_21 World
balances updated — the 22-vector remains the source record

diagrams.title: Dimension Interaction Map
diagrams.description: How the 22 dimensions feed each other. Records and reviews support everything, handoffs pass evidence between dimensions, and the round's closing steps lead to scoring.

diagrams.title: Overall Score Aggregation
diagrams.description: How 22 tallies become one overall score at the end of each round. Money-driven parts never count toward voting. Members review and re-tune the dimension weights by hand before combining.
whoActs: Members review and version the dimension weights
A fairness audit looks for missed care, mediation, and upkeep
An audit checks the weights for distortion
Members decide back-pay or re-tuning when measurement keeps failing

glossary.technical: normalize N_i(C_i) — null-preserving; null never becomes 0 and never decays

glossary.technical: C_11 Justice fairness audit: under-recognized care / mediation / maintenance
C_15 Devil distortion audit of dimension weights

glossary.plain: Members review and version the weights
glossary.technical: governance review of alpha_i weights + versioning

glossary.plain: Save which tuning version was used

diagrams.title: C_0 Fool — Entry
diagrams.description: Rewards being first to step into genuinely new territory. The first step itself is recorded but pays nothing — it earns value only once a reviewer confirms it was real.
whoActs: A reviewer checks the first step

glossary.plain: A reviewer checks the first step

glossary.technical: explanation record — action ID, dimensions, intensities, calibration version

diagrams.title: C_1 Magician — Building
diagrams.description: Rewards building something real. Payment happens on acceptance and is sized by scope — submitting work alone earns nothing.
whoActs: Two reviewers check the work
The credit is set by scope

glossary.plain: Record what was made and prove it is real
glossary.technical: evidence record with action, context, provenance, outcome
explanation record — action ID, dimensions, intensities, calibration version
delivery bounty credited to the C_1 balance

diagrams.title: C_2 Priestess — Recording
diagrams.description: Rewards records that last, are credited to an author, and can be found again. Publishing earns a base credit; every confirmed later use earns a bonus.
whoActs: A reviewer confirms each real use of the record

glossary.plain: A reviewer confirms each real use
glossary.technical: verified retrieval — usage bonus per confirmed use
rails for all dimensions — evidence records
explanation record — action ID, dimensions, intensities, calibration version

diagrams.title: C_3 Empress — Nurturing
diagrams.description: Rewards helping someone else grow. The reward is a share of the mentee's accepted work, capped per mentee and paid once per round.
whoActs: A reviewer confirms the mentee's work was accepted

glossary.plain: Credit a share of the mentee's work
glossary.technical: nurture multiplier — percentage of mentee's accepted output
explanation record — action ID, dimensions, intensities, calibration version

diagrams.title: C_4 Emperor — Rule Changes
diagrams.description: Rewards rule changes the DAO actually adopts — proposing alone earns no credit.
whoActs: Members vote to adopt the change

glossary.technical: governance bounty on the adopted change

glossary.plain: New rule becomes a tuning version
glossary.technical: adopted rule → calibration version, fed to aggregation

diagrams.title: C_5 Hierophant — Teaching
diagrams.description: Rewards teaching proven by someone actually being able to do the thing — lectures and attendance alone get no credit.
whoActs: A reviewer confirms someone can now do it

glossary.plain: A reviewer confirms someone can do it
Share as nurture evidence with Empress

glossary.technical: explanation record — action ID, dimensions, intensities, calibration version

diagrams.title: C_6 Lovers — Joint Builds
diagrams.description: Rewards genuine joint builds, with the shared credit split by proven share of the work.
whoActs: A reviewer confirms it was a real joint build

glossary.technical: declare joint build with attribution shares

glossary.plain: Link the accepted work to Magician

diagrams.title: C_7 Chariot — Milestones
diagrams.description: Rewards completed milestones, reduced or voided if the work caused proven harm.
whoActs: A reviewer confirms the milestone is done

diagrams.title: C_8 Strength — Resolving
diagrams.description: Rewards resolving a live dispute. The resolver must be neutral, the credit is sized by severity, and both sides must accept the resolution in writing.
whoActs: A neutral resolver is picked and checked
Both parties accept the outcome in writing

diagrams.title: C_9 Hermit — Discovering
diagrams.description: Rewards deep research by proven milestones — page count earns nothing. A finding that steers a real vote earns an adoption bonus.
whoActs: A reviewer checks milestone evidence
A reviewer confirms the finding steered a decision

diagrams.title: C_10 Wheel — Fair Round Completion
diagrams.description: Rewards closing a round fairly. If the audit finds the round unfair, the system records the debt and retries next round.
whoActs: A person audits the round's fairness

glossary.technical: cycle debt — measurement failure is the system's debt
fires the cycle-boundary event to aggregation
explanation record — action ID, dimensions, intensities, calibration version

diagrams.title: C_11 Justice — Audits
diagrams.description: Rewards running fairness audits, which stay human-only during the early phase. Missed care, mediation, or upkeep triggers back-pay, re-tuning, or rule retirement.
whoActs: A person runs the fairness audit

glossary.plain: Run the fairness audit by hand
Were quiet kinds of work missed?

diagrams.title: C_12 Hanged Man — Re-seeing
diagrams.description: Rewards reframing a problem in a way that changes a real decision — sitting in a pause earns nothing.
whoActs: A reviewer checks that the decision really changed

glossary.plain: A reviewer checks the decision changed

diagrams.title: C_13 Death — Ending
diagrams.description: Rewards clean endings: learning preserved and resources released. Endings staged for appearance earn no credit.
whoActs: A person checks the learning was preserved
A person confirms resources were released

glossary.plain: Credit the one who closed it

diagrams.title: C_14 Temperance — Health in Range
diagrams.description: Rewards keeping a health measure in a healthy range, with stall detection to catch quiet stops.
whoActs: A person fixes the stall

glossary.plain: Each round checks the health measure
Credit for holding it in range

diagrams.title: C_15 Devil — Exposing
diagrams.description: Rewards exposing a skewed incentive. It needs a second person to confirm, earns one of the largest credits, and false claims are penalized.
whoActs: A second person confirms the claim
A person audits the dimension weights

glossary.technical: corroboration by at least one independent member

glossary.plain: A person audits the dimension weights
glossary.technical: Devil operator audit of weights (human-only bootstrap)

glossary.plain: Integrity credit — one of the largest
glossary.technical: integrity bounty — among the largest payouts
feeds C_11 and aggregation's distortion finding

diagrams.title: C_16 Tower — Crisis Response
diagrams.description: Rewards stabilizing a verified crisis. Spotting one earns nothing, and causing it earns nothing.
whoActs: Moon verifies the crisis is real
The credit is sized by severity

diagrams.title: C_17 Star — Orientation
diagrams.description: Rewards a guide when their new member completes a first proven contribution — running sessions alone gets no credit.
whoActs: A person runs the orientation

glossary.plain: Did the new member finish first proven work?
Share entry progress with the Fool

diagrams.title: C_18 Moon — Verifying
diagrams.description: Rewards finishing verification checks in either direction. Accuracy is tracked against chance, and suspicious reviewer patterns rotate reviewers out.
whoActs: A reviewer checks each pending claim
Reviewers get swapped if capture is suspected

glossary.technical: verification token per completed check, either direction

diagrams.title: C_19 Sun — Public Recognition
diagrams.description: Rewards public recognition only when it links to a proven record — popularity alone earns nothing.
whoActs: A reviewer checks the record

glossary.plain: Link the recognition to the record

diagrams.title: C_20 Judgement — Reckoning
diagrams.description: Rewards settling the round's records — human-only during the early phase. Unresolved judgments stay open and settle when evidence arrives.
whoActs: People settle the records

diagrams.title: C_21 World — Completion
diagrams.description: Rewards completing the whole round once every part is settled. Incomplete rounds wait.
whoActs: A person confirms the round completed

glossary.plain: Close the round so scores can be published
glossary.technical: closes the cycle spine, enables $RCT publication
